facts.text: Sam started a new diet and exercise routine last Monday and reported feeling great.

evidence.quote: I started a new diet and exercise routine last Monday and it's made a huge difference. I feel great!

facts.text: Evan twisted his knee last Friday and is experiencing pain, which has made it difficult to maintain his usual fitness routine.

evidence.quote: Twisted my knee last Friday and it's really painful, so it's been tough to stay consistent with my usual fitness routine.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that staying active is very important to him, but his knee injury has made it frustrating to maintain this.

evidence.quote: It's really frustrating because staying active is like, mega-important to me.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that he is considering physical therapy for his knee injury and plans to keep it low-key and swim to stay active until then.

evidence.quote: PT for my knee is on the cards. Hopefully I'll get an appointment soon. Till then, just keeping it low-key and swimming to stay active.
